label: Is accolade successor
summary: Whether the character is the successor of the given accolade.
details: Write the accolade to check against, as a saved scope or link that leads to an accolade.

label: In global variable list
summary: Whether a target is an entry in a global variable list.
details: Going by its name, the list is a global one, not tied to a single character or title. The game's documentation only shows the shared usage of the list checks. Vanilla writes it as a block with the list's name and the target, for example to check whether a flag is in a list of unavailable decisions.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The name of the variable list.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The thing to look for in the list.
fields.values: a scope, a saved scope or a flag such as flag:my_flag

label: In local variable list
summary: Whether a target is an entry in a local variable list.
details: Going by its name, the list is a local one rather than a global one. The game documents it with the same text as the other list checks, and vanilla has no use of it to show, so nothing more is known.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The name of the variable list.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The thing to look for in the list.
fields.values: a scope, a saved scope or a flag

label: In variable list
summary: Whether a target is an entry in a variable list.
details: The list is found by its name. Vanilla uses it often, with targets such as the saved scope, prev, root, this or a flag, for example to check a list of house names or of rejected traditions.

fields.name: name
fields.text: The name of the variable list.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The thing to look for in the list.
fields.values: a scope, a saved scope such as scope:actor, prev, root, this, or a flag such as flag:my_flag

label: Under council task
summary: Whether the county is currently the target of the given council task.
details: Works on a county title. The task is named by its key, for example the conversion or promote culture task. Vanilla uses it with tasks like task_conversion and task_promote_culture.

label: Under council task or its clone
summary: Whether the county is the target of the given council task or of one of its clones.
details: Works on a county title. The game's documentation does not say what a clone is; its example suggests numbered variants of one task (a county under the first variant also counts when the second is written). The example itself writes the plain key is_target_of_council_task, so it looks copied from the other trigger.

label: Is tax collector
summary: Whether the character is a tax collector.
details: Write yes to require it and no to require the opposite.

label: Is tax collector of
summary: Whether the character is a tax collector of the given character.
details: Vanilla uses it once, with a saved scope named liege.

label: Is theocratic lessee
summary: Whether the character is a theocratic lessee, which means a bishop.
details: Write yes to require it and no to require the opposite.

label: Title is created
summary: Whether the title has been created.
details: Works on a title. Write yes to require it and no for a title that has not been created yet.

label: Title name key in use
summary: Whether any existing landed title already uses the given custom name text key.
details: Takes a localization key. Vanilla uses it once, with a dynasty title key. The documented usage line spells the trigger differently (is_custom_title_name_key_used).

label: Belongs to a title
summary: Whether the men-at-arms regiment belongs to a title.
details: Works on a regiment. Write yes to require it and no for regiments that do not belong to a title.

label: Is titular
summary: Whether the title is titular: it has no de jure counties in it and is not a barony or county.
details: Write yes to require it and no for a title that is not titular. Vanilla mostly checks for no.

label: Tooltip is open
summary: Whether the tooltip with the given name is open.
details: An interface trigger: it only works in a few places in the game's interface. Vanilla uses it with a game concept tooltip name.

label: In travel entourage
summary: Whether the character is travelling and part of the entourage.
details: The travel leader counts as part of the entourage. Write yes to require it and no for the opposite.

label: Is travel leader
summary: Whether the character is travelling and is the active leader of the travel.
details: Write yes to require it and no for the opposite. Vanilla uses it once, with yes.

label: Travels with a domicile
summary: Whether the travel plan is a journey made with a domicile.
details: Works on a travel plan. Write yes to require it and no for the opposite.

label: Is travelling
summary: Whether the character is travelling right now.
details: Write yes to require it and no for a character who is not on a journey.

label: Is tributary
summary: Whether the character is the tributary of someone else.
details: Write yes to require it and no for the opposite.

label: Is tributary of
summary: Whether the character is a direct tributary of the given character.
details: The given character is the one the tributary is checked against. Only a direct tributary counts. For indirect ones use the suzerain-or-above check.

label: Is indirect tributary of
summary: Whether the character is a direct or indirect tributary of the given character, through chains of tributaries.
details: Counts a tributary of a tributary too. Unlike the plain tributary-of check, the given character does not have to be the direct one.

label: Tutorial is active
summary: Whether the tutorial is active.
details: An interface trigger: it only works in a few places in the game's interface. Write yes or no.

label: Tutorial lesson is active
summary: Whether the named lesson is the current tutorial lesson.
details: An interface trigger: it only works in a few places in the game's interface. The documented example is reactive_advice_succession.

label: Lesson chain completed
summary: Whether the tutorial lesson chain with the given key has been finished.
details: An interface trigger: it only works in a few places in the game's interface. Vanilla uses keys like lesson_chain_basics_map.

label: Lesson completed
summary: Whether the tutorial lesson with the given name has been finished.
details: An interface trigger: it only works in a few places in the game's interface. Vanilla uses lesson keys like lesson_declare_war.

label: Lesson step completed
summary: Whether a step of a tutorial lesson has been finished.
details: An interface trigger: it only works in a few places in the game's interface. Write the lesson key and the step key joined by a colon, as lesson_key:step_key.

label: Is twin of
summary: Whether the character is a twin of the given character.

label: Scheme type is basic
summary: Whether the scheme's type is a basic type.
details: Works on a scheme. Write yes or no. Vanilla has no use of it to show what counts as basic.

label: Scheme type is secret
summary: Whether the scheme's type is a secret type.
details: Works on a scheme. Vanilla only ever writes yes.

label: Unborn child of a concubine
summary: Whether the unborn character is a child of a concubine.
details: Write yes or no. Vanilla has no use of it to show.

label: Unborn is known bastard
summary: Whether the unborn character is a known bastard.
details: Write yes or no. Vanilla has no use of it to show.

label: Is uncle or aunt of
summary: Whether the character is an uncle or aunt of the given character.

label: Leased to holy order
summary: Whether the title is leased out to any holy order.
details: Works on a title. Vanilla only writes yes.

label: Is unique
summary: Whether the artifact is unique.
details: Uniqueness is set in the artifact's scripted template. Write yes or no.

label: Kind of unit
summary: Whether the regiment's base men-at-arms type is the given one.
details: Works on a regiment. It checks the base type, such as skirmishers, archers, pikemen, heavy infantry, light or heavy cavalry, elephant cavalry or siege weapons.

label: Is valid scheme agent
summary: Whether the character is a valid scheme agent.
details: Vanilla only writes yes.

label: Valid agent in any slot
summary: Whether the character is suitable as an agent for any slot of the given scheme.
details: The given scheme is the one being checked. Vanilla uses it once, with a saved scheme.

label: Valid agent in slot
summary: Whether the character is suitable as an agent for the given agent slot.
details: The given agent slot is the position in a scheme to fill. Vanilla passes saved agent slots.

label: Valid designated heir
summary: Whether the given character could be named designated heir of the character.
details: It asks whether the given character could inherit one or more of the titles the character holds.

label: Valid for event (debug)
summary: Whether the character is valid for the given event, ignoring the event's cooldown.
details: For debugging only. The game says it does not work in release mode. Write the event key.
